arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom

# Basic glom operations
print('Basic:', glom.glom({'a': 1}, 'a'))
print('Nested:', glom.glom({'a': {'b': 2}}, 'a.b'))

# Using new specifiers
print('Auto:', glom.glom({'a': 1}, glom.Auto))
print('Iter:', glom.glom([1, 2, 3], glom.Iter()))
print('Coalesce:', glom.glom({'a': None}, glom.Coalesce('a', 'b', default=42)))
print('Fill:', glom.glom({'a': None}, glom.Fill('a', default=99)))
print('Let:', glom.glom({'x': 1}, glom.Let({'y': 'x'}, 'y')))
print('Check:', glom.glom(5, glom.Check(type=int)))
print('Inspect:', glom.glom({'a': 1}, glom.Inspect))

print()
print('All glom operations work!')
"
